recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-6197 unless PA separately decides to rename or revise Appointment.created in a future ballot.
issue_request: FHIR-6197 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request to add a new Appointment creation date field for tracking waitlist and other appointment-age workflows. The resolution said to add a field called creationDate recording the date/time the appointment was created.
initial_application: Historical commit 4e7bd447d5bcd34260526609d8337e3c9108ca8e, whose message lists Tracker# 8983,9269,6197, added Appointment.created as a 0..1 dateTime to the Appointment spreadsheet source and added created values to Appointment examples. The 2021 source rework preserved the element in source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists appointment=Appointment in the active [resources] section, so the Appointment StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. The current element name is Appointment.created rather than the Jira prose name creationDate, but the definition and comment carry the requested semantics: the initially created date, distinct from meta.lastModified and stable over the Appointment lifecycle. Direct searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence records and no conflicting later Jira evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml already defines Appointment.created as 0..1 dateTime and Appointment examples include created values. Renaming or duplicating the element to match the Jira prose would be breaking and unnecessary.
